text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Conduct yourself more like a queen…"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Have the dignity of an athlete…"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Be graceful, like a young lady…"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "You need to be more like—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Kawakami, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Are you sure? You look like you've seen a ghost or something.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oho… ohoho, I'm fine. It's truly nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kinko Sho, and I'm waiting for Kawakami Princess at the academy gate.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hello! Are you Kawakami's trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Uh-huuuh, I seeee… Okay, I'm Pearl—Kawakami's roommate.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She's racing today, right? I want you to give her a message for me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Tell her to dance passionately as she makes her way through life! I'm always here to support her!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thank you! …

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Last night, my little Kawakami seemed so shaken. I'm confident there's something she's conflicted about.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've always liked Kawakami. I liked her when she was all brawn, and I like her now with her earnest ambition.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll remember that. Adieu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, in the waiting room for the Kinko Sho…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It may be just a G2 race, but I declared this as my next goal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My fans and everyone else know that I'm running today.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there's something I want to tell everyone once I'm in the paddock.
choice_data_list: Is this something you're sure you want to say?
Is this something you're sure you want to say?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's almost time for the runners to enter the paddock. You want to go see it?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Definitely! I've been watching Kawakami's races ever since that live broadcast!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Kawakami! Tear down the track like you always do!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Make that dazzling pose and shout, "I am a princess!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's she doing? Bowing politely isn't like her at all…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: U-um, I… Just like I proclaimed on TV, I will become a queenly queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll conduct myself in a manner befitting a racer. I'll be honest and considerate toward others and not hurt anyone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll endeavor to behave in a way I can be proud of—both as an Umamusume and as a queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: In other words… I'll live true to myself… without discarding my dignity. I hope to have your continued support…
